entries.reason: The '' default is how this repo spells 'unset' (callers test it for falsiness): the import-under-test / lazy-getter pattern, so a test can import a handler with no env. It adds no second value that can drift from the CDK. Remove this entry to list every site.
lib/utils/inference-scope.ts applies the EU env (AVATARS_ENABLED=false) to EVERY Lambda on purpose, so a function added later cannot miss it; only the avatar code reads it.
lib/utils/inference-scope.ts applies BEDROCK_INFERENCE_SCOPE=eu to EVERY Lambda on purpose (docs/eu-deployment.md); only Bedrock callers read it.
Deliberate fail-CLOSED default (the local-dev origin, never '*'): documented beside create_api_resolver() in feedback_form_handler.py; every test imports handlers through it.
Import-under-test default equal to the CDK's own default ('en', bin/voc-datalake.ts primaryLanguage); the processor suites import the module without it.
Import-under-test default equal to the CDK's own default ('en', bin/voc-datalake.ts primaryLanguage).
Import-under-test default; DEFAULT_ENRICHMENT_CONCURRENCY (5) is the documented value the CDK sets.
Import-under-test default equal to the CDK value (core-stack.ts serviceName 'voc-product-doc-extractor'); the handler has no powertools and names its own log field.
Read-time display redaction (radar_reviews._redacted) is patterns-only by design: PII_COMPREHEND and the DetectPiiEntities grant belong to the ingestion-side functions (docs/source-policies.md).
Briefing quotes are redacted at read time with patterns only (radar_views._quote), like the Radar API; Comprehend runs at ingestion.

The engineering report builder redacts the findings agents wrote with patterns only (engineering/workspace/findings.py calls redact_text without a language, so Comprehend never runs); no Comprehend grant on it. Only with -c engineeringAgents=true.

GET /logs/system redacts the deployment's own log lines at read time with patterns only (shared/system_log_groups.py calls redact_text without a language); no Comprehend grant on the logs API (docs/deployment.md -> System errors).
Unscheduled plugin: ingestion-stack.ts sets the rule name only for a scheduled plugin, and circuit_breaker.py then disables nothing (docs/plugin-architecture.md).
Unscheduled plugin: no schedule rule exists to name (docs/plugin-architecture.md).
Documented operator knob (docs/project-workspace.md: 'which no stack sets, so the fallback of 3600 s applies'); the subscript sits in try/except KeyError, so it is not fatal.

the bus the run monitor's actions publish to (signal.*, msg.answer): the opt-in engineering stack is to set it on the Agents API with its grant (the lead's wiring, docs/autonomous-agents.md); unset, POST /agents/engineering/<run_id>/signals and /messages answer 503 and the reads are unchanged.

voc-engineering-runtime, which applies the run monitor's signals: the opt-in engineering stack is to set it on the Agents API with its grant (the lead's wiring, docs/autonomous-agents.md); unset, POST /agents/engineering/<run_id>/signals and /messages answer 503 and the reads are unchanged.

The board redacts the text agents give it (titles, steps, reasons) with patterns only (quality_gate.text.redact, no language, so Comprehend never runs); no Comprehend grant on it. Only with -c engineeringAgents=true.

The learning loop's lesson drafts go through agent memory's statement hygiene (agent_memory/model.py clean_statement calls redact_text without a language, so Comprehend never runs); no Comprehend grant on the runtime. Only with -c engineeringAgents=true.

The coach the learning loop asks names its model itself (coach/model.py: one allowlisted model, its own bounded client) and takes from shared/converse.py only bedrock_call_with_retry; importing that module is what reaches shared/model_config.py's settings read, which the coach never calls. Unset: the defaults, no table read, and no grant on the aggregates table. Only with -c engineeringAgents=true.

voc-engineering-delivery shares the runtime's code and never asks a model (it records a message and wakes an agent); the name-based graph reaches shared/model_config.py through the runtime module's coach (see the supervisor's entry). Unset: the defaults, no table read. Only with -c engineeringAgents=true.

voc-engineering-start shares the runtime's code and runs start_run only (it writes the run and hands its coordinator's launch on), never asking a model; the name-based graph reaches shared/model_config.py through the runtime module's coach (see the supervisor's entry). Unset: the defaults, no table read. Only with -c engineeringAgents=true.
